name: mapping_holdout_v1
provenance: Blind held-out mapping benchmark. Written before reading the mapper's ABBREVIATIONS, synonym or schematic dictionaries and never tuned against. One author; public-schema tables (Synthea, OMOP person, Salesforce Contact, HubSpot contact, Stripe Charge) recalled from public documentation. Committed 28 minutes before tuning began; that it was written blind cannot be verified from the repository.
split_method: Table-level split, stratified by bucket (the single-table 'negatives' bucket is pooled with 'real_world_standard', which holds the other negatives). Inside each stratum tables are ordered by sha256('datawrap-holdout-v1:' + id); the first ceil(n/2) are 'dev2', the rest 'dev'. 'dev2' was called 'test' until the accuracy review: it was re-measured after each tuning change and two of its rows were cited while tuning, so it is an inspected set, not a blind one. Its answers are still kept out of dictionaries, synonym lists and fixtures (tests/test_mapping_holdout_leak.py). The blind number comes from a separate sealed fixture.

known_overlap_at_freeze.recorded_at: base code origin/feature/Cleanup 32bdc4ba6 (before this benchmark was used), re-recorded with the name+token leak check after the accuracy review
known_overlap_at_freeze.note: Associations between a dev2 answer's source and gold (whole names, or tokens only one side has) that the base code's dictionaries, synonym lists, schematic index, training data and knowledge files already held. They are real contamination: dev2 rows they touch are not evidence of generalisation. tests/test_mapping_holdout_leak.py fails on any association not listed here.
